question: Within the same native starting state, can identical full focal-junction 10s entry/receiving count vectors correspond to different observed 450s network stopping costs?
scope: One descriptive existing-label audit, zero model fits, zero new simulations, zero old-chooser re-evaluation. Not a restart of the closed physical/joint/native-direct-transfer recipes.
cost_exposure: Read the archived450s cost labels explicitly for this new zero-fit mechanism diagnostic. Their former response-gated readout was never activated and remains closed; no cost model or performance claim is introduced. These costs are now exposed diagnostic data for future studies.
grouping: Only within each of the28 fixed same-state groups. Exact equality of all ordered movement x two measured integer counts, across all eight actions including PP. Never align movement positions or action indices across cities/groups. No approximate matching, bin search, response projection or selected subset.
cost: Original450s mean network halted vehicles per controlled lane. Also retain integer stopped-vehicle seconds obtained from the stored450 per-second cost samples times controlled_lane_count. Validate original mean and integer grid rather than manufacture differences from floating rounding.
primary: For each exact response class, retain all members and450s stopping-cost range; separately report the PP class and every same-response nonPP action's signed cost difference from PP. Report group and seed coverage, not independent pair significance.
secondary: On the same fixed classes, inspect first10s stopped-vehicle seconds from the already recorded series. Locate whether a cost difference is present within10s or only after it; do not uniquely attribute its physical cause. Do not change the response horizon or derive a new chooser.
aggregation: Keep both groups of every seed, all classes/actions and zero ranges. Report Cologne and Jinan separately; within-city summaries first average group statistics per seed, then equal seeds. Pair totals are descriptive only; no pooling cities to inflate sample size.
admission: All28 groups complete, exactly8 canonical group-data action rows, ordered movement/label alignment, full450 costs, original receipt checks true including same native starting state and pending population. Receipt branch ordering is mapped by candidate_index. Actual group data have verified canonical0..7 order and arrays align with branch labels/costs.
interpretation: A nonzero same-response cost range demonstrates insufficiency of this10s count vector alone, in these archived single-future trajectories. It does not prove that action timing, input state, fuller response trajectories or a model using them cannot distinguish actions. Zero range is reported as zero, without inventing a deficiency. It does not establish differences in conditional expected costs from this one realized future per action.
network_boundary: Archived Cologne geometry and Jinan conversion_v9 precede the currently repaired Jinan/Hangzhou networks. Do not treat these groups as validated current-network training data or independent confirmation. Existing repaired-network PP logs do not supply unexecuted-action outcomes.
stopping: Complete this fixed audit and identify whether a different response target is justified. No new model, feature/weight/threshold search, native branch or confirmation launch follows automatically. Prior HOLDs and reserved seeds remain unchanged.
execution: Audit on jtl110gpu2 only; read the fixed group tables/receipts server-to-server from HPC shared storage, keeping them in RAM. Pull only compact result/logs; no raw observation or checkpoint downloads.
